text:
sara_ops: Quick announcement — we pushed a short-term capacity bump in ap-southeast-3 (Jakarta).

We increased the MI300 "safety pool" for Dedicated by ~30% to help clear queued reservations and reduce customer wait times while infra finishes the placement changes. This is a controlled, reversible change; policy and metrics are below. :white_check_mark:

mike_infra: FYI the config change landed in infra-config and was rolled to the scheduler. Path: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/ap-southeast-3.yaml`

```yaml
pool_name: mi300-safety-pool-ap-sg3
safety_pool_percent: 30  # temporary bump
burst_policy: zone-surge
quota_window: 1h
note: "rollback planned once placement refactor lands (ETA ~48h)"
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.38 deployed to prod by mike_infra — deploy id `deploy-2026-03-23-1145` :rocket:

tina_product: Is there any customer-facing impact? Need wording for CS if we send a note.

sara_ops: Minimal impact on running jobs — this only affects allocation of new Dedicated reservations. Customers currently queued should start seeing their reservations fulfill faster. Putting a short CS blurb in #support now.

ryan_apac: Ops in Jakarta started warming extra nodes and watching NVLink/thermal metrics. Will post live graphs to the dashboard. Ping me if you want to shadow the metrics.

olivia_support: I'll draft a short message for the status page and the CS template: "We applied a short-term capacity increase in Jakarta to improve reservation fulfillment. No action required from customers." Will paste in #support for review. :memo:

mike_infra: Monitoring checks added: `mi300_pool_fill_rate`, `queue_age_p95`, `node_temp_avg`. Alert thresholds lowered for the next 24h. If any of these fire, oncall will auto-scale back down and open a ticket.

sara_ops: Rollback plan: revert `safety_pool_percent` to previous value and drain excess nodes gracefully. Tentative rollback window: 48–72 hours post-change unless placement rollout finishes earlier.

kevin_ceo: Nice work moving fast and safe on this. Keep me posted if we need exec comms. :clap:

sara_ops: Will do — updating the internal runbook and will add a short postmortem note in #eng-postmortems if any unexpected issues pop up.
